tooltips.disableBaseDamage: Damage from structures built through base-building is disabled.
tooltips.disableContainerDamage: Disable damage from items such as tents and barrels.
tooltips.disableRespawnDialog: Disable the UI dialogue window where the player selects the type of respawn after pressing the respawn button.
tooltips.disableRespawnInUnconsciousness: Disables the "Respawn" button in the pause menu (Esc) when the player is unconscious, disallowing them to respawn.
tooltips.disablePersonalLight: Disables the omnipresent personal light that lights up objects close to the player during night-time.
tooltips.spawnGearPresetFiles: If not empty, enables loading and processing of Player Gear Spawn JSON configuration file(s).
tooltips.sprintStaminaModifierErc: Modifies the rate at which stamina is consumed during erected sprint.
tooltips.sprintStaminaModifierCro: Modifies the rate at which stamina is consumed during crouched sprint.
tooltips.staminaWeightLimitThreshold: This amount of stamina points (divided by 1000) will not count towards stamina weight deduction.
tooltips.staminaMax: Maximum stamina. Setting to 0 may produce unexpected results.
tooltips.staminaKgToStaminaPercentPenalty: Multiplier used when calculating stamina points deducted from max stamina given the player load.
tooltips.staminaMinCap: Minimum size of stamina cap. Setting to 0 may produce unexpected results.
tooltips.sprintSwimmingStaminaModifier: Modifies the rate at which stamina is consumed during fast swimming.
tooltips.sprintLadderStaminaModifier: Modifies the rate at which stamina is consumed during fast ladder climbing.
tooltips.meleeStaminaModifier: Modifies how much stamina is consumed when performing heavy melee attacks and evasion.
tooltips.obstacleTraversalStaminaModifier: Modifies how much stamina is consumed when performing jumping, climbing and vaulting.
tooltips.holdBreathStaminaModifier: Modifies the rate at which stamina is consumed when holding breath.
tooltips.shockRefillSpeedConscious: Shock value recovery while the player is conscious (per second).
tooltips.shockRefillSpeedUnconscious: Shock value recovery while the player is unconscious (per second).
tooltips.allowRefillSpeedModifier: Allow/disallow modifier of Shock value recovery based on ammo type settings (typically faster waking-up from unconscious after getting shot).
tooltips.timeToStrafeJog: Time to blend strafing (diagonal movement) while jogging. Min possible value 0.01.
tooltips.rotationSpeedJog: Rotation speed of the character while jogging. Min possible value 0.01.
tooltips.timeToSprint: Time to reach sprint from jog. Min possible value 0.01.
tooltips.timeToStrafeSprint: Time to blend strafing (diagonal movement) while sprinting. Min possible value 0.01.
tooltips.rotationSpeedSprint: Rotation speed of the character while sprinting. Min possible value 0.01.
tooltips.allowStaminaAffectInertia: When enabled, allows the stamina value to influence the player's inertia.
tooltips.staminaDepletionSpeed: Rate at which stamina depletes while drowning/underwater (per second). Higher = faster drown.
tooltips.healthDepletionSpeed: Rate at which health depletes while drowning/underwater (per second). Higher = faster drown.
tooltips.shockDepletionSpeed: Rate at which shock depletes while drowning/underwater (per second). Higher = faster drown.
tooltips.staticMode: Static weapon obstruction mode. 1 = enabled (weapon lowers when colliding with walls/objects), 0 = disabled.
tooltips.dynamicMode: Dynamic weapon obstruction mode. 1 = enabled (more reactive obstruction based on movement), 0 = disabled.
tooltips.lightingConfig: What type of lighting will be used during night time. 0 = bright, 1 = dark (default).
tooltips.objectSpawnersArr: File names of the JSON files containing spawner data (Object Spawner).
tooltips.environmentMinTemps: Minimum environment temperatures per month (Jan–Dec). Affects player temperature & survival.
tooltips.environmentMaxTemps: Maximum environment temperatures per month (Jan–Dec). Affects player temperature & survival.
tooltips.wetnessWeightModifiers: Values for item weight modification based on wetness level. Left to right: [DRY, DAMP, WET, SOAKED, DRENCHED].
tooltips.playerRestrictedAreaFiles: If not empty, enables loading and processing of player restricted areas JSON configuration file(s).
tooltips.disableIsCollidingBBoxCheck: Allows placement when the hologram is colliding with objects in the world.
tooltips.disableIsCollidingPlayerCheck: Allows placement when the hologram is colliding with the player.
tooltips.disableIsClippingRoofCheck: Allows placement where placing would cause clipping with the roof.
tooltips.disableIsBaseViableCheck: Allows placement on dynamic objects and other otherwise incompatible base.
tooltips.disableIsCollidingGPlotCheck: Allows placement of garden plots despite incompatible surface type.
tooltips.disableIsCollidingAngleCheck: Allows placement despite exceeding roll/pitch/yaw limits.
tooltips.disableIsPlacementPermittedCheck: Allows placement even when not permitted by rudimentary checks.
tooltips.disableHeightPlacementCheck: Allows placement with limited height space.
tooltips.disableIsInTerrainCheck: Allows placement when clipping with terrain.
tooltips.disableColdAreaPlacementCheck: Allows placement of garden plots when the ground is frozen.
tooltips.disableColdAreaBuildingCheck: Allows building in cold areas when the ground is frozen.
tooltips.disallowedTypesInUnderground: Prevents construction of these item types (including inherited ones) in underground areas.
tooltips.disablePerformRoofCheck: Allows construction when clipping with the roof.
tooltips.disableIsCollidingCheck: Allows construction when colliding with objects in the world.
tooltips.disableDistanceCheck: Prevents construction when the player gets below a specified range.
tooltips.disableItemFalling: Prevents constructed items from falling to the ground after placement.
tooltips.disableDropAttachmentsOnFall: Prevents dropping attachments when an item falls.
tooltips.disableRefundMaterialsOnFall: Prevents refunding construction materials when an item falls.
tooltips.use3DMap: Enables use of the 3D map only (disables the default 2D map overlay).
tooltips.hitDirectionOverrideEnabled: Decides whether the hit-indicator values get used. Allows the game to determine that valid data was loaded.
tooltips.hitDirectionBehaviour: Dictates general behaviour of the hit indicator. 0 = Disabled, 1 = Static, 2 = Dynamic (moving when displayed, WIP).
tooltips.hitDirectionStyle: Dictates which type of indicator gets used. 0 = splash, 1 = spike, 2 = arrow.
tooltips.hitDirectionIndicatorColorStr: Color of the indicator widget, in ARGB format (e.g. "0xffbb0a1e").
tooltips.hitDirectionMaxDuration: Maximal duration of the hit indicator. Actual duration is 0.6–1.0 of this value depending on hit severity.
tooltips.hitDirectionBreakPointRelative: Fraction of the duration after which the indicator begins to recede. 0.0 = fades from start, 1.0 = no fading.
tooltips.hitDirectionScatter: Amount of scatter (inaccuracy) in degrees. A value of 10 gives ±10° (20° total) potential scatter.
tooltips.hitIndicationPostProcessEnabled: Allows disabling of the old hit effect (red flash).
tooltips.ignoreMapOwnership: Player can open a map (just the map) using the dedicated input ("M") even without a map in their inventory.
tooltips.ignoreNavItemsOwnership: Compass and/or GPS receiver are not needed for displaying helpers on the 2D map.
tooltips.displayPlayerPosition: Show the player's position on the map. true = visible, false = hidden.
tooltips.displayNavInfo: Display navigation info/helpers on the map.
tooltips.boatDecayMultiplier: Multiplies the speed of boat decay. Higher = boats decay faster.
tooltips.canDetachAttachedCarWheels: Allows detaching wheels that are attached to cars.
tooltips.canDamageAttachedCarWheels: Allows damaging wheels that are attached to cars.
tooltips.canDetachAttachedBikeWheels: Allows detaching wheels that are attached to bikes.
tooltips.canDamageAttachedBikeWheels: Allows damaging wheels that are attached to bikes.

presets.label: Unlimited Stamina
presets.description: Near-zero drain on every action. Sprint, swim, melee forever.

presets.label: Better Stamina
presets.description: Halved drain, higher carry threshold, more max stamina.

presets.label: Vanilla Default
presets.description: Stock DayZ values — the original Bohemia balance.

presets.label: Hardcore Drain
presets.description: Double drain, lower carry threshold, less max stamina.

presets.label: Fast Recovery
presets.description: Double refill speeds — shake off shock quickly.

presets.label: Fast Movement
presets.description: Snappy strafe & sprint transitions, quick rotation.

beleuchtung.label: Bright Nights
beleuchtung.description: Default DayZ lighting. Night-time is bright and visible. Easier spotting, less atmosphere. Good for casual/PvE servers.

beleuchtung.label: Dark Nights
beleuchtung.description: Pitch-black nights, immersive atmosphere. Flashlights & NVGs matter.

beleuchtung.label: Sakhal Brighter Nights
beleuchtung.description: Sakhal map lighting — brighter nights tuned for the Sakhal environment. Use on Sakhal missions for clearer night visibility.

beleuchtung.label: Custom Preset 3
beleuchtung.description: Not officially documented. Map-specific custom lighting — only works if the mission defines it.
